At a road near hospital, collided with victim Yuan (袁某) riding an electric scooter, causing injuries to both. Police arrived, took blood sample; during process, defendant bit police officers, tearing uniform, causing injury to officer Zhang (right index finger bite) and officer Yi (易某) also bitten (right hand finger). The accident: defendant was main responsibility. Blood alcohol 178.27 mg/100ml (which is over 80 mg/100ml, so drunk driving). The electric scooter is considered electric light motorcycle. The rule says: Only assign 故意伤害 when intentional act results in actual bodily injury meeting statutory threshold. Here he bit causing injury (轻微伤). So could be 故意伤害罪. Usually Chinese law: If the act is violent and causes injury, it can be charged with "妨害公务罪" (Article 277) which includes assaulting police. But also "故意伤害罪" (Article 234) if injury.
